BiblicalUsage: Bada means to invent — to devise a thing out of one's own head. Jeroboam invented a feast in the eighth month, like the feast in Judah, and set up the calves at Bethel; and Sanballat said Nehemiah invented the rebuilding of the wall out of rebellion. One man invented false worship, and the other was falsely accused of inventing treason.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that invented religion is the oldest sin in the book, and Jeroboam's feast is my warning: if God did not command it, I do not want it, however good it looks.
